from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single expense metric extracted from one company's financial document."""
    company: str = Field(description="The name of the company the document reports for")
    label: str = Field(description="The exact label of the expense line item as written in the document")
    amount: float = Field(description="The numeric value of the expense")
    unit: str = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period this expense covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_records: list[ExpenseRecord]
